name: media-advisor
description: Zero-API homelab cinema concierge: Reads local Plex/Jellyfin SQLite databases directly in read-only mode to analyze watch history, in-progress items, user ratings, and unwatched library gems. Cross-references real-time theatrical releases, streaming platform drops, and community buzz with anti-seeding sentiment verification. Renders recommendations as 2-column visual cards with local poster thumbnails.
